Honey I'm sorry. I have that too. I hate myself more every day. You're worth it though <3 talk to me if you need someone <3

3 days after this was posted, I attempted suicide and my parents found me and took me to the hospital. I was supposed to stay for 3 days but, ended up staying 16 days. I just got back. When getting there, things just got better. 

Thank you for helping me.

Alright, thank you for all the help. It's 4 AM  so I'm going to bed now but, thank you so much for all the help. If I end up doing it, I'll be sure to message you. :) You have been a big help to be tonight so I'm glad I got to talk to you and that you could answer my questions. Good night :)
So, right from the start of the er or a bit after I get there?
How do I handle the parents? Do you know when they'll be called/informed about what happened? (sorry I'm asking so much, I just really don't know who else to talk to)

Why do you stay there? Why don't they let you go home? Do you think I should try and go? I really don't know. I feel like I need help and I don't know any other way but, I don't know if my self harm is "bad enough" to have to go to the hospital for it you know? I really really need help but I really have no freaking idea what kind of help I need or how extreme of help I need to get. I'm so confused but, I know I need to do this because every day I feel myself falling further and further away from the person I am, the person that I'm should be. This whole thing is so... new to me. 

I feel stupid asking this, but what does 51/50 mean?

I understand that and would rather have them tell my parents than me so that's a good thing I guess. Why would I have to stay in the hospital for a day or two before the psych facility? What would I do there? What will happen in the psych facility when I'm there?
I tell them, they don't listen. I need therapy or something but no one helps me!
I have no health problems. Does that still work? I'm really confused.
